title: When Everything Changes
introduction:
展览前言｜回忆

回忆，从不是对过往的机械复刻，它更像一场永不落幕的动态生长。它游离于遗忘与重构的夹缝之间，不断重塑自我的形态。

每一次回望，都是一次新的生长；每一次缄默，都沉淀出新的生命痕迹。记忆从未静止，始终在时光流转中更迭、演变，成为贯穿生命的温柔脉络。

本次展览以记忆、身体、时间为核心脉络，重构人与岁月、生命与情绪的联结。画面中的植物、肌理、色彩与光影，褪去了具象物象的辨识属性，成为承载个体经验、封存私人情绪的艺术媒介。它们搭建起真实与想象交织的精神场域：身体留存岁月的温度，植物镌刻生命的轨迹，色彩沉淀情绪的褶皱，让无形的时间与记忆，化作可被看见、可被感知的视觉诗意。

作品里的覆盖与擦拭、堆积与裂痕、重叠与留白，皆非创作的偶然落笔，而是时间最本真的印记。一如真实的记忆，从不完整恒定，它会生长、会消散、会堆叠、会隐没，又在某个瞬间破尘而出，以全新的姿态与我们重逢。于此，绘画不再只是视觉图像的创造，更是一场以笔墨、肌理、色彩书写时间、留存记忆的诗意仪式。

整场展览没有既定叙事，没有标准答案，只为留白与共鸣。

我们期待观者步入展境，以自我阅历为底色，与作品温柔对话。每一次凝神凝视，都是一次记忆的唤醒；每一次驻足停留，都是一次情感的重逢。那些被时光尘封的细碎感触、那些无法被言语穷尽的温柔与怅然，都将在画面的缝隙里，重新拥有清晰的轮廓与温度。

回望回忆，从来不是为了沉溺过往、折返旧日时光。而是在流动不息的当下，与逝去的岁月、真实的自己温柔重逢。在无声的画面里，触摸时间的重量，感知身体的记忆，捡拾生命散落的细碎痕迹，读懂时光沉淀的温柔与力量。
introduction-en:
EXHIBITION FOREWORD | MEMORY

Memory is never a mechanical reproduction of the past. It is more like a continuous process of becoming.

It exists between forgetting and reconstruction, constantly reshaping who we are. Every return becomes a new beginning; every silence leaves behind traces of new life. Memory is never still. It moves with time, transforming and evolving into a gentle thread that runs through our existence.

This exhibition takes memory, the body, and time as its central threads, exploring the connections between people and the passing years, between life and emotion. Plants, textures, colors, and light move beyond the specificity of recognizable objects, becoming artistic mediums for carrying bodily experiences and preserving personal emotions. They create a space where reality and imagination intersect: the body retains warmth as it remembers, while plants trace the trajectories of life, and color settles like the sediment of emotion. The intangible qualities of time and memory become something visible, something that can be sensed.

The marks of covering and rubbing, accumulation and erasure, layering and leaving traces are not accidental remnants of the creative process, but the most authentic impressions of time. Like memory itself, they never remain fixed. They grow, fade, accumulate, disappear, and, at certain moments, break through again, reconnecting with us in a new form. Painting, therefore, is no longer simply the creation of visual images, but a ritual of writing and preserving memory through brushstrokes, texture, and color.

This exhibition offers no predetermined narrative and no definitive answers. It simply leaves space for silence and resonance.

I invite viewers to enter the exhibition with their own experiences as a starting point and to engage in a quiet dialogue with the works. Every moment of looking becomes an awakening of memory; every silence becomes an act of reconstruction. Those fragments of sensation sealed away by time, and those moments of tenderness and regret that cannot be fully expressed through language, may find their contours and warmth again within the spaces between the paintings.

To look back at memory is never to remain trapped in the past or to fold old moments into nostalgia. Instead, it is to reconnect with the passing years and gently reconstruct the self within the ceaseless flow of the present.

In these silent surfaces of those paintings, I touch the weight of time and trace the roots of thoughts that anchor us to the world. Nourished by the tenderness and strength left behind by time, these roots extend deep into our inner soil, gathering the scattered traces of life and allowing them to bloom once more into a living consciousness.

Memories forge a weighted future — or do they?
